title: docs(core,plugin-auth,plugin-security): name the config-derived backstop instead of the retired elevation gate at four sites
body:
Fixes #14046

The #11663 platform-admin re-anchor (leg L4) retired the walled platform-admin
**elevation gate**. Under a walled posture `bootstrapPlatformAdmin` writes no grant row
and elevates nobody — it reports — and standing is derived per request at
`resolve-authz-context.ts` §6b-config, from a config-anchored verified email or the
legacy unscoped grant row.

Four sites still named the retired mechanism. They split into two classes that cost
different things to verify, so this PR is deliberately graded for a **non-comment** diff.

## Class A — comments (no executable line moves)

| Site | Correction |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/core/src/security/platform-admin.ts` (module header, Choice 1A) | Said `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` is the name plugin-security's "elevation refusal" quotes. plugin-auth's boot refusal IS still a refusal; plugin-security's is `bootstrapPlatformAdmin`'s fail-closed backstop for an undeclared/refused config (`walled_owner_email_undeclared`) plus the config-derived standing log. Reworded to the shape already pinned one file over in `packages/types/src/env.ts` |
| `plugin-security/src/walled-platform-bucket-diagnostic.test.ts` | Said the `error` sink receives the "walled elevation refusal". It receives the "ZERO config-derived platform administrators" backstop, which refuses over **configuration**, not over elevation (`bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` routes exactly that message to `logger.error`) |

Wording follows the already-pinned shapes — `platform-admin-service.ts:21`,
`types/src/email-verified.ts:15`, and the corrections #13903 landed — rather than
anything invented here.

## Class B — test titles (executable lines)

| Site | Before → after |
| --- | --- |
| `plugin-auth/src/walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts` | `it('the email comparison MIRRORS the elevation gate: …')` → `… MIRRORS the platform-admin derivation: …` |
| `plugin-security/src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.test.ts` | `describe('[#12974] the shared row predicate (the elevation gate’s twin)')` → `(the per-request derivation’s twin)` |

A `describe`/`it` title is a string literal, not a comment: it survives a
`removeComments` strip and shows as a changed executable line. That is why this work
could not ride a comment-only card, and why the byte-identity criterion used there is
not used here.

One further edit rides Class B: the header of `walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts`
carried a forward reference — "One `it()` title below still names the gate … left for
the card that can price it" — which this PR's own rename makes false. It is updated in
the same commit. It is not a fifth defect site: it does not name the gate, and the
grep census below is unchanged at four.

## Verification

**Census / reverse control.** `git grep -n -i 'elevation gate\|elevation refusal' -- packages`
returns 14 hits on `origin/main` and 11 after this change. Sorted by text (line numbers
normalised away):

- 4 hits present before and absent after — exactly the four sites above;
- 1 hit added — the rewritten class-A paragraph, itself now a correct "no longer an
  ELEVATION refusal" statement;
- **10 hits byte-identical in both** — the correct survivors (they say "retired", or are
  past tense, or are the corrections #13903 / #13661 wrote). No blanket search-and-replace.

**Class A carries no executable change; Class B carries exactly one line each.**
Transpiling each file at both revisions with `removeComments: true` and diffing the
non-empty output lines:

| File | Class | Differing stripped lines |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `core/src/security/platform-admin.ts` | A | **0** |
| `plugin-security/src/walled-platform-bucket-diagnostic.test.ts` | A | **0** |
| `plugin-auth/src/walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts` | A+B | **1** — the `it()` title, and nothing else |
| `plugin-security/src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.test.ts` | B | **1** — the `describe()` title, and nothing else |

**Both suites green, and the test COUNT is unchanged** — the criterion that rules out a
botched title silently skipping a `describe` block. Measured on the same built tree, the
before-run taken by checking the three test files out of the merge base and restoring
them from `HEAD` afterwards (restore proven by `git diff HEAD` empty and per-file blob
hashes matching `HEAD`):

| Suite | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-auth` `walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts` | 1 file, **28 passed** | 1 file, **28 passed** |
| `plugin-security` `platform-owner-wall-bypass` + `walled-platform-bucket-diagnostic` | 2 files, **25 passed** | 2 files, **25 passed** |

**No consumer depends on either title.** Re-checked on this tree, not taken from the
card: each title string occurs only at its own definition site; the repo contains no
`-t` / `--testNamePattern` invocation at all; and neither package has any snapshot file.

**Gates**, derived live with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
(29 runnable commands, both output sections, harvested with `--commands`), each exit
captured before any pipe, all on commit `9039b4868`:

- **26 green**, including `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:engine-double-contract`,
  `check:where-matcher`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`,
  `check:test-source-alias`, `check:comment-mask-adoption`, `check:doc-authoring`,
  `check:i18n` (measured after building the closure it prescribes), `check:i18n-stale-fill`,
  `check:nul-bytes`.
- **3 NOT MEASURED**, each printing its own PREREQUISITE NOT MET verdict rather than a
  finding: `check:test-completeness` (exit 3 — wants a saved `turbo run test` log),
  `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3) and `check:type-check-debt` (exit 3), both of
  which need the whole workspace built. That build was cut short twice by this
  container's 10-minute foreground limit under lock contention. CI builds fully and
  measures all three.

`pnpm typecheck` for `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` passes.
Two scope notes stated rather than glossed: `@objectstack/core` declares no `typecheck`
script (it is covered by the ledger `check:type-check-coverage` greens), and plugin-auth's
tsc program does not include `walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts` (`--listFiles`: 0 hits),
so its typecheck says nothing about that file — vitest loading and running it does.
plugin-security's `tsconfig.test.json` does include both of its edited test files.

## Notes

- No changeset: this diff is comments plus test-title strings and publishes nothing from
  any package, so it carries `skip-changeset`.
- #13903 is complete at its seven comment sites and is not reopened here; per the PM
  ruling in the issue body, `walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts:257` (now `:270`) was
  mis-listed on that card's table and is carried here instead.
